svg.title: One passage, two ways to edit it: unbounded polishing and Academic Writing Assistant
svg.desc: An informal synthetic manuscript passage. Unbounded polishing sounds more professional but drops the hedges, turns 92.3% into 92% and replaces the method in [12] with “existing methods”; with Academic Writing Assistant the language becomes just as professional while hedges, numbers and citations stay as written, and the edit explains what changed and what the author should confirm.
